annotations.content:
## Best Indonesian Food in Ubud

Indonesian lunch Mads Lade at Capella

### NusantarA

I am always surprised by how many people who travel to a place like Bali but are scared to try street food. If you are one of them but still want to get a whole Indonesian dining experience you have to eat at [Nusantara](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8ozR4a1BV6bHFVcY7) .

It has been a firm favorite amongst the Ubud restaurant scene and is part of the Locavore family (more about those in a moment). Nusantara offers a unique take on Indonesian classics in a beautiful, modern setting.

The menu is organized by small plates and mains as well as sides, rices, and sambals. Each dish also shows where it comes from in Indonesia. If you think Indo has nothing to offer but satay and mie goreng you are in for a very pleasant awakening.

Each meal starts with the most incredible “Berbagi Rasa” snack wheel accompanied by a cute card explaining what you are eating.
